annotations.text:
Direction: "Paper ledger" — warm paper surfaces, ink-black actions, Space Grotesk numbers.
Data colors appear only in the cost-breakdown bars and table swatches.
Cars and numbers are realistic samples computed with the actual TCO formulas (20 000 km/yr, 5 years).

Two rough alternate directions, structure only.
If one of these feels more like it, say so and the three screens get rebuilt in that style.
